name: Mosheng Ren
source:
"Hello! Is Lu Xu there? I heard he works here?" A girl came to a strange city, a strange shop and asked timidly. What is she looking for? What is waiting for her?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“喂！陆旭在吗？听说他在这里工作？”一个女孩来到陌生的城市，陌生的商店，胆怯地问道。她在找什么？等待她的是什么？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830490/]Steam[/url]]
